title: Taskbase 2019 — Angular single-page site
stack: Angular 5 AOT production bundle (runtime/polyfills/main + extracted styles.css), Bootstrap 4, Source Sans Pro
notes: The Angular bundle the archive stored actually boots and renders the whole page — the archive kept index.html, runtime/polyfills/main and the extracted styles.css, and both Google Fonts stylesheets (?family=Source+Sans+Pro and ?family=Roboto|Source+Sans+Pro) plus their gstatic TTFs, so the type is the real Source Sans Pro at weight 400, which is all Google was asked for. What the crawl never took was the assets/ tree: 84 images and the three bundled TTFs (ariblk, bahnschrift, thaisan) were recovered file-for-file from the monorepo at commit e314d3ce, dated the same day as the snapshot (2019-01-15) — same bytes, not substitutes. Recovering blackboard.jpg, electrobg.svg and customers/left.svg is what turned the page from washed-out to right: the "Unser Angebot" section is white chalk on a blackboard, not grey on grey. Fully offline: the NLP demo endpoints (api.taskbase.com), the contact form's Firebase function and the @agm/core Google Maps loader are repointed at a local not-archived/ path so they 404 instantly instead of hanging or phoning home — the map on team/impressum is therefore an empty 400px band, and demo buttons and the form do nothing. Deep links stubbed: team, impressum, examples/*, technology/0-5. The technology route is numeric here even though the same-day source had already moved to technology/:link; the deployed build is the older shape. Footer year is computed at runtime, so it reads 2026.
